newsitem.title: CHILE: Canada's Toronto-Dominion opens Chile unit.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Toronto-Dominion opens Chile unit.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank has opened a representation office in Chile as part of its plan to boost investment in Latin America's Southern Cone region, said president Charles Baillie.
"We are very excited as there are great opportunities for growth and investment by Canadian companies," said Baillie.
Canada is one of the top foreign investors in Chile, with investments of around $6 billion, mostly in the fast-growing mining sector.

Toronto-Dominion has invested $200 million in Chile and expects to see this rise with loans not only to mining companies but firms in the financial services, telecommunications and forestry industries, Baillie told reporters.
Toronto's Santiago office will be responsible for the bank's investments in six countries in the region.
-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-669-5595x212 (c) Reuters Limited 1996
